noise_assumptions.notes: Uses the organizer benchmark noise rates as design assumptions. The official benchmark applies its own unchanged noise model.

design_rationale: A four-qubit linear processor matches the four-qubit ZZFeatureMap used by the Q2 quantum-kernel classifier. Bidirectional nearest-neighbor connections support the linear entanglement pattern and reduce the need to reverse directed two-qubit operations. The native rx, ry, rz, and cx gates are compatible with the organizer's noisy-run basis. Task B's three-qubit QFT provides a separate test of routing overhead, circuit depth, and fidelity on this processor design.
